label: end-of-episode clock (last ~10 trials), D1/D2 steps
explanation: An episode-time unit. It is essentially silent before trial ~50 (0 of ~480k steps before trial 40), rises through trials 70-89, and 91% of its activation mass is in the last 10 trials of the episode (trials 90-99), where it fires on 44% of steps. Within those trials it fires on the fixation/feedback steps D1 and D2 and almost never at GO (GO lift 0.1x). It tracks the value head closely: value < 5.22 (bottom decile) holds 94% of the mass, which matches the value falling as the episode nears its end. Within the late window, firing and magnitude vary with the trial history (the strongest windows are runs of unrewarded trials after an unseen reversal, with activation growing step by step), but no simple history predicate separates them. Restricting to value < 5.5 or ep_trial >= 92 changes F1 by only ~1 point. The recorded predicate (ep_trial >= 90 and not GO) gives dev F1 0.70 and mass recall 0.89. Its misses are mostly weak activations in trials 80-89, and its false positives are late D1/D2 steps where the unit stays below threshold. It uses no future variables: elapsed episode time is something the agent can track internally.
